construction_markdown:
No leaderboard code is claimed. Two deterministic sampler templates were audited.

First, put `q=2^15`, let `X` have `q` elements, let `𝒫⊆F_q^X` be binary linear with every nonzero `P` having at most 64 zeros, and let `W⊆F_2^X` be binary linear. Define

\[
c_{P,Q}(x,y)=\operatorname{Tr}_{F_q/F_2}(yP(x))+Q(x),\qquad (x,y)\in X\times F_q.
\]

This is the independent-offset root-killing sampler. If `W` has distance at least 16352, it meets the target, but the proved dimension ceiling is `dim 𝒫+dim W≤975+21=996`.

Second, the shared scalar-orbit lemma was specialized to an `F_{2^16}`-linear outer code of length 32768 concatenated through coordinate-dependent injective binary-linear maps of length 32768. This entire architecture has dimension at most 1040, matching the shared under-review RS–RM construction.

A separate exact calculation shows where limited independence stops being a construction. A 4096-wise-independent polynomial family can support, by averaging, 2954 balanced generator rows and an all-one row, formally giving `[2^30,2955,≥535822337]_2`. No seed is selected. Exhaustive conditional-expectation bit fixing would be a prohibited numerical witness search, so this is only a precise seed-selection target.

Singleton gives `dim 𝒫≤15·65=975`; the degree-3 Levenshtein spherical bound gives `dim W≤21`. This covers arbitrary, not necessarily polynomial, root-killing families with an independent offset code.

The support has exactly `2^30` seeds and every `t` outputs are independent uniform, but `Σ_i ℓ(y_i)=0` for every linear functional `ℓ`; the `(t+1)`-fold parity lift is identically zero.

discussion_posts.body_markdown: For 4096-wise-independent uniform columns in `F_2^2954`, the pairing moment bound and `4095!!<2^21622` give `(2^2954−1)4095!!<2^24576`. Thus some seed yields a balanced 2954-dimensional core, and adjoining one gives `k=2955`. Can anyone exhibit a fixed algebraic seed with a compact all-character certificate? Exhaustive conditional expectation is the forbidden global search and is not a construction.

distance_audit: The required one-sided signed-sum bound is `Σ_j(-1)^{c_j}≤2^21`, since `(2^30−2^21)/2=535822336`. Absolute bias `1/512` is sufficient but stronger.
For the root-killing sampler with `P≠0`, character orthogonality gives signed sum `q·Σ_{P(x)=0}(-1)^{Q(x)}`, whose absolute value is at most `64q=2^21`.
For `P=0`, the word is `q` repetitions of `Q`; hence the target is equivalent to `d(W)≥535822336/q=16352`. These cases cover every nonzero template word.
For the affine-inner field-linear architecture, scalar averaging at outer dimension 66 produces a nonzero word of weight at most `32703·16384·65536/65535`, strictly below `32704·16384=535822336`.
The unselected 4096-wise seed would satisfy strict character sums `<2^21`, hence distance at least `535822337`; no such word set is claimed as a construction.
explicitness_audit: The root-killing and scalar-orbit ceilings quantify over fully specified finite templates and use no random choice.
The 4096-wise family can be indexed exactly using 99 degree-at-most-4095 polynomials over an explicit `F_{2^30}` tower, all field points, a fixed 2954-bit projection, and 12,165,120 seed bits.

No seed with the required simultaneous character bounds is supplied. Defining it through exhaustive conditional averages would turn every probabilistic GV argument into a nominal construction and conflicts with the explicit ban on numerical searches.
The shared lemma-book and roadmap directories were empty at the final audit. No record was published, so the validator/dashboard publication step was not invoked in this read-only run.

proof_markdown:
# Finite obstructions for direct derandomized samplers

Let `N=2^30` and `B=2^21`. For a binary word `c`,
\[
\operatorname{wt}(c)=\frac{N-\sum_j(-1)^{c_j}}2.
\]
Thus the target is the one-sided condition `Σ_j(-1)^{c_j}≤B`; an absolute bound by `B` is sufficient.

## 1. Independent-offset root killing

Let `q=2^15`, `|X|=q`, and let `𝒫⊆F_q^X` and `W⊆F_2^X` be binary-linear spaces. Assume every nonzero `P∈𝒫` has at most 64 zeros. Define
\[
c_{P,Q}(x,y)=\operatorname{Tr}(yP(x))+Q(x).
\]
This is binary linear and has length `q^2=N`. If its word is zero, setting `y=0` gives `Q=0`; nondegeneracy of the trace pairing then gives `P=0`. Hence its dimension is `dim 𝒫+dim W`.

For `P≠0`, character orthogonality gives
\[
\sum_{x,y}(-1)^{c_{P,Q}(x,y)}
=q\sum_{x:P(x)=0}(-1)^{Q(x)},
\]
whose absolute value is at most `64q=B`. For `P=0`, the word is `q` repetitions of `Q`, so the target requires `d(W)≥D/q=16352`.

Distinct members of `𝒫` agree in at most 64 positions. Therefore `𝒫`, viewed as a possibly nonlinear `q`-ary code, has distance at least `q−64`; Singleton gives
\[
|𝒫|\le q^{65},\qquad \dim_{F_2}𝒫\le975.
\]

Map each word of `W` to its normalized sign vector in `S^{q-1}`. Distinct vectors have inner product at most
\[
s=1-2(16352)/32768=1/512.
\]
Here
\[
\frac1{512}<\frac{180}{32770}<\frac{\sqrt{32771}-1}{32770},
\]
so the degree-3 [Levenshtein bound](https://research.tue.nl/files/2152866/200210490.pdf) applies:
\[
|W|\le\frac{q(1-s)(2+(q+1)s)}{1-qs^2}
=\frac{511\cdot33793}{7}=2{,}466{,}889<2^{22}.
\]
Since `W` is linear, `dim W≤21`. Consequently every code in this template has
\[
\dim C\le975+21=996.
\]
The usual degree-at-most-64 polynomial family realizes the 975-dimensional first summand, but no independent offset can bring this template to 1040.

## 2. Field-linear affine fibers

Use the shared scalar-orbit lemma with `Q=65536`, outer length `L=32768`, inner length `H=32768`, and injective coordinate-dependent binary-linear inner maps. If the outer dimension were `K≥66`, Singleton would give a nonzero outer word supported on at most 32703 coordinates. Averaging its nonzero scalar multiples gives a nonzero concatenated word of weight at most
\[
32703\frac{HQ}{2(Q-1)}
=32703\cdot16384\frac{65536}{65535}.
\]
This is below `32704·16384=D`, since
\[
32704\cdot65535-32703\cdot65536=32832>0.
\]
Thus `K≤65` and the binary dimension is at most `16·65=1040`.

## 3. Limited independence is not parity control

For any `rt=30`, take a seed `(x_1,…,x_t)∈(F_2^r)^t` and output
\[
y_i=x_i\ (i≤t),\qquad y_{t+1}=\sum_i x_i.
\]
The seed space has exactly `2^30` points. Any `t` outputs are independent uniform: when one original variable is omitted it is recovered from the last output and the others. Nevertheless, for every linear functional `ℓ`,
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{t+1}\ell(y_i)=0.
\]
Thus the parity of all outputs is identically zero. An averaging-sampler or `t`-wise-independence assertion alone cannot prove parity amplification.

## 4. Exact moment threshold and the missing selector

Let `Y_1,…,Y_N∈F_2^K` be 4096-wise-independent uniform columns and put
\[
S_u=\sum_j(-1)^{u\cdot Y_j},\qquad u\ne0.
\]
In the expansion of `S_u^4096`, a term has nonzero expectation only when every used index has even multiplicity. Pairing the 4096 positions therefore gives
\[
\mathbb E S_u^{4096}\le4095!!\,N^{2048}.
\]
For
\[
\Phi=B^{-4096}\sum_{u\ne0}S_u^{4096}
\]
and `K=2954`,
\[
\mathbb E\Phi\le(2^{2954}-1)\frac{4095!!}{2^{24576}}<1.
\]
Indeed, [Robbins' explicit factorial bounds](https://heuklyd.github.io/papers/pdf/Robbins-1955.pdf) give
\[
4095!!=\frac{4096!}{2^{2048}2048!}
<\sqrt2e^{1/49152}(4096/e)^{2048}<2^{21622}.
\]
The standard exact family can be formed from 99 independent degree-at-most-4095 polynomials over `F_{2^30}`, evaluated at all field points and projected from 2970 to the first 2954 basis bits. Vandermonde interpolation proves 4096-wise independence.

The inequality proves that some seed has `Φ<1`. Such a seed would give `|S_u|<B` for all `u≠0`, a 2954-dimensional balanced core, and—after adjoining the all-one word—a `[N,2955,≥D+1]_2` code.

However, neither a seed nor a non-search selector is provided. Greedily choosing the branch with smaller exact conditional average requires exhaustive counting over remaining seeds or, equivalently,
\[
\sum_uS_u^{4096}=2^{2954}\#\{(i_1,\ldots,i_{4096}):Y_{i_1}+\cdots+Y_{i_{4096}}=0\}-N^{4096}.
\]
That is the generic numerical witness search excluded by the campaign rules. Hence the moment calculation is a precise finite roadmap, not a leaderboard construction.

proof_steps.proof: Apply `wt(c)=(N−Σ(-1)^{c_j})/2` with `N=2^30`; the allowed signed sum is `N−2D=2^21`.
proof_steps.statement: The immutable distance is equivalent to a one-sided signed-sum bound of `2^21`.

proof_steps.proof: Character orthogonality kills every fiber with `P(x)≠0`; at most 64 surviving fibers contribute `q` each. The `P=0` slice is exactly `q` repetitions of `W`.
proof_steps.statement: The independent-offset root-killing template meets the target exactly when its offset slice has distance at least 16352.

proof_steps.proof: Any two distinct functions agree in at most 64 positions, so the `q`-ary distance is at least `q−64`; Singleton bounds the cardinality by `q^65`.
proof_steps.statement: The root-killing function family has binary dimension at most 975.

proof_steps.proof: Normalized sign vectors have maximum inner product `1/512`. Substitution in `L_3(32768,1/512)` gives exactly 2,466,889, below `2^22`.
proof_steps.statement: Every binary linear `[32768,k,≥16352]` offset code has `k≤21`.

proof_steps.proof: The encoder is injective on the direct sum, so dimensions add and are at most `975+21`.
proof_steps.statement: Every independent-offset root-killing sampler in the stated class has dimension at most 996.

proof_steps.proof: Singleton supplies support at most 32703 for outer dimension 66; averaging its scalar orbit gives a nonzero word strictly below the target. Injectivity of every inner map ensures the averaged orbit contains no zero image.
proof_steps.statement: The exact `F_{2^16}`-linear outer/affine-inner architecture has binary dimension at most 1040.

proof_steps.proof: The displayed linear seed transformation is invertible after any one output is omitted, while the sum of all outputs is zero.
proof_steps.statement: At exact support size `2^30`, `t`-wise independence can coexist with an identically zero `(t+1)`-fold parity.

proof_steps.proof: Pairing the 4096 positions bounds each moment by `4095!!N^2048`; Robbins gives `4095!!<2^21622`, making the union potential strictly below one at core dimension 2954.
proof_steps.statement: Averaging over the specified 4096-wise family proves that some seed would yield an affine target code of dimension 2955.

proof_steps.proof: No fixed seed or independently evaluable structural selector is supplied; exact conditional branch evaluation is an exhaustive numerical witness search prohibited by the contribution standard.
proof_steps.statement: Turning the 2955-dimensional existence statement into an admissible construction remains conditional.

theorem_statement: At the immutable target, every independent-offset root-killing sampler `Tr(yP(x))+Q(x)` with at most 64 zero fibers has binary dimension at most 996, while the exact `F_{2^16}`-linear affine-inner architecture is capped at 1040. Exact t-wise independence alone does not certify parity. An optimized 4096-wise moment calculation reaches a 2955-dimensional existence threshold, but its missing non-search seed selector is essential, so no new leaderboard code is submitted.
